SELECT s.id, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name, s.gender, s.college, s.major, s.class_name AS className, s.special_type AS specialType, COUNT(a.id) AS applyCount, (SELECT a2.status FROM grant_application a2 WHERE a2.student_id = s.id ORDER BY a2.create_time DESC, a2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latestStatus FROM student s LEFT JOIN grant_application a ON a.student_id = s.id
AND s.counselor_id = #{counselorId}
AND (s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY s.id, s.student_no, s.name, s.gender, s.college, s.major, s.class_name, s.special_type ORDER BY s.student_no
